from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import json,requests,hashlib,re,time,threading
OUT=Path("reports/research/510300_bank_industry_constraint_source_probe_v1")
ledger=json.loads((OUT/"request_ledger.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
urls=["https://www.nfra.gov.cn/chinese/docfile/2026/9a20b3d34d24444bbdd77a210675a95c.xls"]
assert len(ledger)+len(urls)<=8 and not set(urls)&{x["url"] for x in ledger}
budget=16777216-sum(x.get("bytes",0) for x in ledger)
used=0;lock=threading.Lock()
def stamp():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def fetch(url):
 global used
 x={"url":url,"tool":"requests","started_at":stamp(),"retry":False,"raw_saved":False,"role":"官方年度表当前正文attachmentInfoVOList列出的原xls附件，不假设历史版本"}
 try:
  r=requests.get(url,timeout=(10,25),stream=True,headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
  x.update({"status":r.status_code,"final_url":r.url,"headers":dict(r.headers)})
  r.raise_for_status();chunks=[];start=time.monotonic()
  for chunk in r.iter_content(65536):
   with lock:
    used+=len(chunk)
    if used>budget: raise RuntimeError("冻结总字节预算达到")
   if time.monotonic()-start>35:raise RuntimeError("冻结请求时间上限达到")
   chunks.append(chunk)
  raw=b"".join(chunks);name=urlparse(url).path.rsplit("/",1)[1]
  (OUT/name).write_bytes(raw)
  x.update({"raw_saved":True,"raw_path":(OUT/name).as_posix(),"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
  x["magic_hex"]=raw[:12].hex()
 except Exception as e:x["error"]=type(e).__name__+": "+str(e)
 x["completed_at"]=stamp();return x
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:results=list(pool.map(fetch,urls))
ledger.extend(results)
(OUT/"request_ledger.json").write_text(json.dumps(ledger,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"官方原表下载":results,"已用唯一直链":len(ledger)},ensure_ascii=False))

try:
 import xlrd
 source=OUT/"9a20b3d34d24444bbdd77a210675a95c.xls"
 if source.exists():
  book=xlrd.open_workbook(str(source))
  cells=[]
  for sheet in book.sheets():
   for ri in range(sheet.nrows):
    row=[sheet.cell_value(ri,ci) for ci in range(sheet.ncols)]
    if any(v!="" for v in row): cells.append({"sheet":sheet.name,"excel_row":ri+1,"values":row})
  (OUT/"当前年度原表_全部非空行.json").write_text(json.dumps(cells,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
  print(json.dumps({"原表全部非空行":cells},ensure_ascii=False))
except Exception as exc:
 (OUT/"原表读取错误.json").write_text(json.dumps({"error":type(exc).__name__+": "+str(exc),"packages_installed":0},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
 print(json.dumps({"原表读取":type(exc).__name__+": "+str(exc)},ensure_ascii=False))
